about: Golden cases for layout::composite_layout. 'upstream:' cases copy the inputs and the asserted values of OpenScreen v2.1.2 src/lib/compositeLayout.test.ts (only what that test asserts is listed under expect). 'derived:' cases were computed by hand from the rules in compositeLayout.ts:447-646; the arithmetic is in 'math'. Rects are output pixels [x, y, width, height]; maxContentSize = canvas is padding 0, 1536x864 in 1920x1080 is padding 50 (fixed format). Upstream's default mask is 'rectangle' with roundness 0.4 and size 40, anchor bottom-right.

cases.name: small screen scaled up to the canvas
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > scales small screen content up to the export canvas when no padding is applied

cases.name: rounding-only aspect gap snaps to the canvas
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > snaps rounding-only source aspect gaps to the full canvas

cases.name: dual-frame without a camera falls back to the screen
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > falls back to the screen alone in dual-frame when the clip has no camera (screen, camera) + masks the screen with its box for the two block presets only (dual-frame without a camera -> screenCover false)

cases.name: vertical-stack without a camera falls back to the screen
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > falls back to the screen alone in vertical-stack when the clip has no camera

cases.name: camera capped at 60 % of the short side
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > caps the camera at 60% of the short side (648 x 365) + keeps the same margin from the border at every anchor (bottom-right: right edge 1920-22, bottom edge 1080-22, margin = round(1080*0.02) = 22; x = 1898-648, y = 1058-365)

cases.name: size above the range clamps to 60
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > caps the camera at 60% of the short side (size 80 -> height 365)

cases.name: top-left anchor at the minimum size
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > keeps the same margin from the border at every anchor (top-left at WEBCAM_SIZE_MIN: x = y = margin = 22)

cases.name: fully round square is a circle
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > rounds by the roundness, and a fully round square is a circle (width == height, borderRadius = width / 2)

cases.name: roundness 0 draws square corners
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > rounds by the roundness, and a fully round square is a circle (roundness 0 -> borderRadius 0)

cases.name: picture-in-picture does not cover the screen
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > masks the screen with its box for the two block presets only (picture-in-picture -> false)

cases.name: no-webcam does not cover the screen and has no camera
cases.source: upstream: computeCompositeLayout > masks the screen with its box for the two block presets only (no-webcam -> false)

cases.name: camera-only fills the frame
cases.math: compositeLayout.ts:466-479: webcamRect = [0, 0, canvas], radius 0, rectangle; screenRect = centerRect(canvas, screen, maxContent) = whole canvas for a 16:9 screen at padding 0
